title: srd hud maker error on deployed games.

posts.author: SamSan
posts.body:
Hi im using rpg maker mv with the plugin srd hud maker and everything works fine until i deploy the game, then i get an error "of Null" on launch and cant start a game.
I tried many things already but I am still unable to solve the issue. The error only shows up once the game is deployed, even though every files are there.
